Bug_Title: "@SpringBootApplication" and "@ComponentScan" should not be used in the default package
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by using @SpringBootApplication and @ComponentScan annotations on a class in the default package, which causes unnecessary scanning of the entire classpath and potential startup issues.
